high_level_description: The image depicts two women standing indoors, smiling at the camera. The woman on the left is wearing an orange traditional outfit with floral embroidery on the front. She has a gold necklace and her hair is styled neatly. The woman on the right is dressed in a green traditional outfit with floral embroidery and is holding a baby wrapped in a yellow blanket. The baby appears to be sleeping peacefully. Both women have traditional bindis on their foreheads.
